verdict.rationale: Factory runs the same Droid runtime across the web/desktop App, the CLI, and IDE integrations (VS Code, JetBrains, Zed). Users can redirect work in place through inline diff comments and design mode, and the Sessions API can drive a session's lifecycle and messages. However, no evidence explicitly shows a developer picking up an already-running agent task on another surface (e.g., moving a web session into the terminal or editor) and taking control of it. Missing for 10: documented cross-surface session handoff/resume, explicit mid-task takeover or interruption controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
